calculation.description: At each date, reverse each instrument's 20-day return residual versus the equal-weight cross-asset 20-day return and normalize by its trailing 20-day realized volatility. All inputs are observable through the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: No qualifying observations were available in 2020-2025 because the combined 15-asset data had insufficient valid cross-sectional coverage under the 8-name minimum. 2026-2028 IC 0.071041 (630 dates); 2029-2031 IC 0.046687 (783 dates); 2032-2035 IC 0.0517517 (1025 dates). Interpret conservatively given the 15-instrument universe and incomplete early history.

provenance.signal_artifact_format: date-indexed wide CSV with one column per tradable instrument
provenance.library_correlation_note: Not computed reliably because legacy artifacts contain non-finite values; deterministic post-Miner audit must recompute from real finite signal rows.
